row.body: A route map sends the delivery past the station, but the receipt records it as closed before the driver reached the turn.
row.title: The station diversion

sidecar.gloss: A delivery route remains open on the map after the station was recorded closed.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field supply run could have taken the same diversion; the receipt does not say why access ended.

row.body: the duct tape and hand radio were sealed together but never opened. soot darkens the bundle; clean outlines show it was packed before the fire.
row.title: missing count beside the duct tape

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
